blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-privacy-1 (E-mail address and display name written to the application log) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-privacy-2 (E-mail address sent to the Beacon analytics SaaS) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence: log.info("new signup email=%s name=%s id=%s", email, display_name, user_id)
findings.recommendation: Log only the opaque id (`log.info("new signup id=%s", user_id)`). As written, every sign-up copies the member's e-mail address and display name into the logs, which have their own retention, access and shipping, and which account erasure does not reach (GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) data minimisation, Art. 5(1)(e) storage limitation, Art. 17 erasure).
findings.title: E-mail address and display name written to the application log

findings.recommendation: Drop `email` from the event properties: the stated purpose is to count sign-ups ("Sign-ups are counted in product analytics"), which needs no e-mail address — `track("signup", {"user_id": user_id})`, or no identifier at all. As written, each member's e-mail address is shared with the third-party processor at beacon.example.com, beyond what the purpose needs, and erasure of the account does not reach it (GDPR Art. 5(1)(c), Art. 28).
findings.title: E-mail address sent to the Beacon analytics SaaS

findings.evidence: """Product analytics, sent to the Beacon SaaS (beacon.example.com)."""
findings.recommendation: Question for the team: the change introduces a new third-party recipient of member data (Beacon), which the proposal does not name. State whether a processing agreement exists (GDPR Art. 28), where Beacon processes data (transfer outside the EEA, Chapter V), and add it to the record of processing (Art. 30). Only the controller can tell what was decided.
findings.title: New analytics processor Beacon not identified as a processor or transfer

findings.evidence: - [x] personal-data — collects e-mail addresses and display names
findings.recommendation: Question for the team: the proposal names the data collected but not its lawful basis (Art. 6), how long the `users` rows are kept, nor how a member's account and its copies (logs, analytics events) are erased (Art. 5(1)(e), Art. 17). State them in the plan.
findings.title: Purpose, lawful basis and retention of the sign-up data not stated
